source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over data/catalog/items.json only; every number ground-checked against the item, failing lines dropped

items.absolution: For attack-speed fighters facing magic damage: being immobilized triggers a brief damage-reduction and movement-speed buff.
items.abyssal-dart: An assassin's opener: land the dart on a lone target, then teleport onto them to finish the kill and slow their escape.
items.aegis-of-agawar: For bruisers who want damage plus a safety net: armor and magic resist grow stronger once your health drops low in fights.
items.alternata: For physical casters built around their alternate ability: it hits harder, and casting it trims your other ability cooldowns.
items.alternator: Buy early on physical casters who lean on their alternate ability; use your abilities to stack it, then upgrade it at base.
items.amulet-of-chaos: For mages who dump a full combo: activate it to refresh most of your basic abilities and refill mana for a second round.
items.ashbringer: For crit carries who mix abilities into basic attacks: each hit shortens your cooldowns, so you cast far more often in long fights.
items.assassin-crest: The upgraded crest for physical assassins: it keeps you healed while fighting, then evolves into a legendary crest at base.
items.astral-catalyst: For mages who join every fight: kills and assists bring your ultimate back much sooner, and you punch through shields harder.
items.augmentation: For fighters who weave abilities between attacks: every few seconds your next basic attack hits much harder, with some health for safety.
items.azure-core: For mages who want mana and a safety shield: it grows over time from farm and camps, then adds bonus magic power.
items.basilisk: For physical fighters facing tanky frontliners: repeated hits strip their armor, and you gain bursts of movement speed to stick to them.
items.berserkers-axe: For melee bruisers who need to stick: an empowered hit slows the target, and you get speed bursts to chase through fights.
items.brutallax: A fighter's active for when crowd control (stuns/roots) keeps catching you: remove every debuff and shrug off more while you keep swinging.
items.catalytic-drive: A support tank's starter: periodically execute a minion with your basic attack for gold and a small heal, then upgrade at base.
items.caustica: For mages facing enemies who stack magic resist: it ignores a big chunk of it and punishes healthy, tanky targets.
items.champion-crest: The upgraded crest for fighters: heals you over time during fights, then evolves into a legendary crest at base.
items.citadel: For physical bruisers who frontline against physical damage: you gain armor and weaken the armor of enemies around you.
items.claw-of-hermes: For tanky mages fighting mana-hungry enemies: burn their mana for extra true damage, especially against ranged heroes.
items.combustion: For burst mages who clear waves and poke groups: your hits periodically explode for area damage around the target.
items.consort-crest: A support's starter crest: poke while near an ally to earn gold without taking minion farm, then it evolves into Keeper Crest.
items.crescelia: For magic supports and hybrids who poke with basic attacks: each empowered hit on a hero adds a little extra gold.
items.crystal-tear: For enchanter supports who heal and shield: your buffs also give you and your ally a burst of magic power and haste.
items.crystalline-cuirass: For tanks against magic damage: getting hit stacks extra magic resist and, when fully stacked, bonus movement speed.
items.cursed-ring: For hybrid attack-speed carries who rely on on-hit effects: you attack far faster but each basic attack hits a bit softer.
items.cursed-scroll: For durable attack-speed brawlers: each hit costs you some health to hurt the target, with heavy regeneration to keep you up.
items.cybernetic-drive: The upgraded support tank item: keeps the minion execute and area heal, and adds a share of extra armor and magic resist.
items.dawnstar: For frontliners against basic-attack carries: your hits make enemies deal less damage, especially if you fight in melee range.
items.deathstalker: For attack-speed carries facing armored targets: each hit shreds armor, and you gain a big burst of attack speed.
items.demolisher: For crit carries when the enemy stacks armor: ignore a large share of it, especially on bonus armor bought by tanks.
items.demon-edge: For physical assassins who burst through shields: deal extra damage into shielded targets and get a speed burst to chase.
items.devotion: For enchanter supports keeping carries alive: heals and shields are stronger on low-health allies, and you shrug off big hits.
items.draconum: For sustained physical fighters: build up stronger healing in long fights and get a chunk of health back when you need it.
items.dread: For physical fighters facing burst mages: a reusable shield absorbs magic damage, returning when you avoid hero damage for a while.
items.dreambinder: For mages who want to kite or catch: every ability slows targets, with extra health so you survive the fight.
items.dust-devil: For crit carries who kite: hitting stacks attack speed and, when fully stacked, extra movement speed to reposition.
items.dynamo: For tanky initiators: after you lock someone down, they take more damage from your team; it adapts to physical or magical builds.
items.earthshaker: For melee bruisers who chain abilities: landing hits ramps your ability damage, stacking faster as a melee hero.
items.echelon-cloak: For fighters who ambush: go invisible, regain some health and mana, and hit harder right after stepping out.
items.elafrost: For tank junglers: empowered attacks hit everything around the target and slow it, with bonus damage to jungle monsters.
items.enras-blessing: For supports protecting carries: when a nearby ally gets stunned or rooted, they automatically get a shield.
items.entropy: For mages who hit with many abilities: every ability adds a little extra damage, great for spammy or multi-hit kits.
items.envy: For physical fighters who want a pick: your next basic attack after an ability crits, and you can briefly silence the target.
items.epoch: A mage's safety active: freeze yourself in stasis to dodge a deadly combo or wait out tower shots.
items.equinox: For crit carries who get dived: a big emergency shield scales with level and buys time to keep attacking.
items.everbloom: For enchanter supports: your heals and shields also give allies some damage reduction and resistance to crowd control.
items.eviscerator: A carry active for all-in fights: pop it for bonus attack speed, lifesteal on everything, and harder-hitting basic attacks.
items.exodus: A carry or fighter active for peeling: lob a grenade that knocks enemies back, then hit them harder while they recover.
items.fire-blossom: For armored tanks who stand in fights: burn nearby enemies constantly, with damage ramping the longer they stay near you.
items.fist-of-razuul: For health-stacking fighters: empowered attacks scale with your health, heal you, and clear minion waves faster.
items.florescence: A support's ward-holding item: place a bounce pad that lets your team jump over walls to engage or escape, plus an extra ward.
items.flux-matrix: For tanks with magic-damage teammates: enemies you hit take more magic damage and get stunned or rooted for longer.
items.frosted-lure: For armored frontliners: activate it to damage and slow nearby heroes, then get shielded based on the damage dealt.
items.frostguard: For tanks facing basic-attack carries: anyone near you attacks more slowly, with both armor and magic resist for mixed damage.
items.gaia-greaves: For armored tanks who roam: build up movement speed while walking, then spend it on a hard-hitting basic attack.
items.galaxy-greaves: For supports and mages who need both resistances cheaply: extra movement speed and a periodic higher jump to cross walls.
items.gamma-gloop: A tank's engage active: jump in, ground everyone around you, and leave a slowing puddle so they cannot escape.
items.gaussian-greaves: For tanky mages who dive: double jump to land a damaging, slowing shockwave, with armor and movement speed.
items.giants-ring: For armored tanks who spam abilities: every hit shortens cooldowns, and the active makes you bigger and tougher for a few seconds.
items.golems-gift: For mages against physical assassins: armor and power that you keep while casting, but lose as physical heroes hit you.
items.goliath-crest: The upgraded tank crest: steady healing over time in fights, then evolves into a legendary crest at base.
items.gravitum: A fighter's catch tool: fire a long-range bolt that grounds the first hero hit, stopping jumps and dashes.
items.guardian-crest: A support's starter crest: heal yourself and earn gold while near an ally, without taking minion farm; evolves into Keeper Crest.
items.hexbound-bracers: For mana-hungry tanky supports: taking damage refills mana, and you take less damage from enemy basic attacks.
items.iceskorn-talons: A fighter's team-fight active: create an ice field that gives allies power and speed while slowing enemies on it.
items.imperator: The pure crit damage item for carries: your critical strikes hit much harder, best once you already crit often.
items.infernum: For physical casters in drawn-out fights: repeated hits set targets on fire for damage based on their max health, strong into tanks.
items.inquisition: For tank junglers and frontliners against magic: empowered attacks send out an area wave that clears camps quickly.
items.judgement: A bruiser's sustain active: hit everyone around you, healing for each hero struck to stay in extended brawls.
items.keeper-crest: The upgraded support crest: poke near an ally for gold without taking minion farm, then evolves into a legendary crest.
items.leafsong: A support's ward-holding item: speed up your whole team to chase or escape, ignoring slows; also adds an extra ward.
items.legacy: For physical fighters against heavy crowd control (stuns/roots): cleanse yourself and become immune to it for a short window.
items.liberator: A carry's escape active: cleanse every debuff and gain a shield when a stun or root would get you killed.
items.lifebinder: For mages who need sustain: magic lifesteal heals you from ability damage, growing a little stronger over time.
items.lifecore: For damage-dealing supports: dealing damage charges a healing wisp that automatically heals your lowest-health ally.
items.lightning-hawk: For crit carries who kite: moving and attacking charges an empowered shot that adds damage and slows the target.
items.lunaria: For enchanter supports who also poke: dealing damage stores charges that turn into a heal on your lowest-health ally.
items.luxforge-lantern: For physical junglers and roamers: takedowns and killing wards permanently grow your physical power, plus movement speed.
items.magician-crest: The starter crest for mages: restores mana as you fight, then evolves into Wizard Crest.
items.magnify: For mages in long fights: each hit strips the target's magic resist, with health and omnivamp to survive.
items.malady: For physical assassins who chase kills: targets explode on death, and takedowns reset an extra burst of damage.
items.manta-scythe: For physical carries who farm: clear minions and small camps faster, and deal more damage to isolated targets.
items.marksman-crest: The starter crest for carries: small lifesteal and attack speed in lane, then evolves into Sharpshooter Crest.
items.marshal: For magic-power heroes who basic attack often: adds attack speed and extra damage on every hit, growing with level.
items.megacosm: For mages against health-stacking tanks: abilities burn a share of the target's max health, extra against bonus health.
items.mesmer: For physical fighters against a key catch ability: a spell shield blocks the next enemy ability that would land on you.
items.mindrazor: For physical casters who fight in groups: your hits splash damage around the target, with extra physical power.
items.mistmeadow-buckler: For physical bruisers against magic poke: a refilling barrier blocks part of incoming damage, with strong health regeneration.
items.mutilator: For physical casters against tanks: abilities deal damage based on max health, and omnivamp heals you through fights.
items.necrosis: For attack-speed carries with a strong ultimate: much more ultimate haste and a harder-hitting ultimate.
items.nex: A physical assassin's burst active: store some of the damage you deal, then release it on nearby heroes with a slow.
items.nightfall: For physical casters who dive: abilities heal you on heroes, and a level-scaling shield keeps you alive mid-combo.
items.noxia: For burst mages: marking a hero then hitting them with a separate ability adds damage based on their max health.
items.nuclear-rounds: For attack-speed carries whose abilities matter: big attack speed plus a flat boost to ability damage.
items.nyr-warboots: A tank's escape and reset active: a burst of fading movement speed while regenerating health quickly.
items.oathkeeper: For magic-power heroes who weave in basic attacks: each ability empowers your next hit with heavy extra damage.
items.obelisk: A mage's snowball active: an empowered attack that grows stronger and adds magic power each time you finish a kill.
items.oblivion-crown: The raw-damage item for mages who want pure burst: a huge pile of magic power, multiplied further by its passive.
items.occult-crest: The starter crest for mages who need health: heals you during fights, then evolves into Warlock Crest.
items.omen: For physical fighters who rely on cooldowns: charged attacks hit harder and cut your non-ultimate cooldowns.
items.orb-of-enlightenment: The upgraded mage sustain item: permanent bonus power and health, plus missing-health regeneration after taking damage.
items.orb-of-growth: For mages who want early sustain: farm and takedowns grow it, then upgrade at base into Orb of Enlightenment.
items.orion: For mages who basic attack between spells: ability haste from items also grants attack speed, and repeated hits ramp your damage.
items.ortus: A physical snowball active: gain speed and power, and takedowns during it permanently add physical power.
items.overlord: For health-stacking bruisers: basic attacks cleave around the target, and kills and camps permanently add health.
items.overseer: For mages who need sustain in fights: more damage overall and healing from damage you deal to heroes.
items.pacifier: A carry's finisher active: dash in and empower your next hit, which hurts much more on low-health targets and can recast after kills.
items.painweaver: For physical assassins: hitting stacks extra penetration and movement speed, helping you chase and burst squishy targets.
items.penumbra: For physical casters who rotate abilities: each cast trims your other cooldowns, with health and haste for skirmishes.
items.plasma-blade: For hybrid crit carries with both physical and magic power: repeated hits stack extra critical strike chance.
items.prophecy: For magic-power heroes who basic attack: attack speed plus on-hit magic damage for sustained trading.
items.pygmy-dust: A support's ward-holding item: shrink an enemy so they slow down and deal less damage, or shrink an ally to speed them up.
items.raiment-of-renewal: For tanks in long fights: a huge health pool that regenerates quickly as you lose health, plus resistance to crowd control.
items.rapture: For attack-speed bruisers: basic attacks deal bonus on-hit damage, with health and omnivamp to keep brawling.
items.razorback: A tank's active against burst: briefly gain extra armor and magic resist and reflect damage back to hero attackers.
items.rebirth: For physical fighters who get focused: after dying, revive on the spot a few seconds later with part of your health.
items.reclamation: A support's ward-holding item: cleanse yourself and nearby allies of crowd control (stuns/roots) at the key moment.
items.resolution: For on-hit physical fighters who farm: extra on-hit damage, and stacked mana eventually grants bonus physical power.
items.rift-walkers: A support's ward-holding item: dash forward and pull nearby enemy heroes toward you to start a fight.
items.rogue-crest: The starter crest for physical assassins: heals you as you fight, then evolves into Assassin Crest.
items.ruination: For crit physical heroes against mana users: drain their mana over time and deal true damage that ignores resistances.
items.salvation: For melee bruisers diving in: a big shield plus omnivamp when you commit, and resistance to crowd control.
items.sanctification: A support's ward-holding item: shield yourself and nearby allies, giving them resistance to crowd control while it holds.
items.saphirs-mantle: A tank's growth active: grow larger, damage nearby heroes, and permanently gain max health from the damage dealt.
items.scattershot: For crit carries who fight groups and clear waves: each hit fires homing projectiles at nearby enemies.
items.sharpshooter-crest: The upgraded carry crest: lifesteal and attack speed while you farm, then evolves into a legendary crest at base.
items.silentium: A support's ward-holding item: silence a priority hero so they cannot cast their escape or combo.
items.sky-splitter: For attack-speed carries against tanks: each hit deals damage based on the target's current health, with lifesteal.
items.solaris: For crit physical casters: empowered attacks after abilities can crit and heal you for part of the damage.
items.solstice: For tanky physical fighters: build up a charge to unleash a heavy hit that heals you for more than it deals.
items.soulbearer: A mage's survival active: a shield plus magic lifesteal and movement speed when you get jumped.
items.soulbinder: For long-range mages who poke: extra damage on very long-range hits, and permanent power as you land abilities.
items.spear-of-desolation: For physical casters with a strong ultimate: more ultimate haste and a damage boost to follow up.
items.spectra: For attack-speed carries who finish fights: stacking hits triggers bonus damage that grows on low-health targets.
items.spellbreaker: For mages against a key catch ability: a spell shield blocks the next ability, plus extra magic power and magic resist.
items.spirit-of-amir: For magic junglers: lifesteal while clearing camps, more power outside the jungle, and bonus damage to monsters.
items.stonewall: For tanks against physical damage: heavy armor and health regeneration, mitigating part of every physical hit.
items.storm-breaker: For attack-speed fighters who clear waves: charged attacks release lightning that chains between many targets.
items.syonic-echo: For physical fighters who reset basic attacks: abilities speed up your next attacks, with heavy lifesteal.
items.tainted-bastion: Anti-heal for tanks against magic healers: enemies who hit you heal less, and you take less damage from them.
items.tainted-blade: Anti-heal for physical bruisers: your hits cut the target's healing and make them take more damage.
items.tainted-charm: Anti-heal for supports and tanks: nearby enemies heal less and are slowed, with resistance to crowd control.
items.tainted-guard: Anti-heal for armored tanks: physical attackers who hit you heal less and bleed for damage.
items.tainted-rounds: Anti-heal for crit carries: hits cut healing and deal more damage as the target's health drops.
items.tainted-scepter: Anti-heal for mages: abilities cut the target's healing and deal stacking bonus damage, filled instantly by takedowns.
items.tainted-totem: Anti-heal for supports: cut enemy healing yourself and pass the same effect to an ally.
items.tainted-trident: Anti-heal for physical assassins and casters: your damage cuts healing and adds bonus damage.
items.tempest: A mage's brawl active: repeatedly damage nearby heroes and heal from it, best when diving into a group.
items.terminus: For lifesteal-heavy crit carries: healing beyond full health turns into a shield, so you survive burst after topping off.
items.the-perforator: For physical casters when the enemy stacks armor: ignore a large share of it and lightly slow targets you hit.
items.time-flux-band: A mage's reset active: mark your spot, dive in for a combo, then teleport back with cooldowns refreshed and some mana.
items.timewarp: For mages who spam abilities: very high ability haste and every hit shortens your non-ultimate cooldowns.
items.titan-crest: The starter crest for tanks: heals you over time in fights, then evolves into Goliath Crest.
items.tranquility: A support's ward-holding item: heal yourself and nearby allies and give them brief damage reduction in a team fight.
items.transference: For tanky supports and frontliners: leftover shields turn into health, plus armor, magic resist, and movement speed.
items.truesilver-bracelet: For supports against crowd control: a shield makes you immune to stuns and roots while it holds, then explodes.
items.typhoon: For magic-power heroes who basic attack: hits stack attack speed, and the active gives a short dash to reposition.
items.tyranny: For physical fighters who chain takedowns: gain speed and ability haste, refreshed by kills, plus ultimate haste.
items.unbroken-will: For tanks against magic damage and crowd control: high health and magic resist, with an extra armor boost under pressure.
items.vainglory: For tanks who stay in long fights: armor and magic resist that grow steadily the longer you are in combat.
items.vanguardian: A cheap tank item for supports: both resistances plus crowd control reduction to survive the first engage.
items.vanquisher: For crit physical carries who finish fights: execute low-health targets before they can escape or be healed.
items.viper: For attack-speed carries against armored enemies: hits strip armor and boost both on-hit and ability damage.
items.void-conduit: For tanky heroes who run out of mana: omnivamp for sustain and regeneration that refills missing mana.
items.void-helm: For tanks who rely on healing: every heal and lifesteal source on you restores more, with high health and magic resist.
items.voidgazer: A mage's catch active: a long skillshot that slows and makes the target take more damage for a short time.
items.volcanica: For tanky fighters who cast often: abilities shorten your other cooldowns, especially when you cast your ultimate.
items.vyzar-carapace: For physical bruisers: hitting a hero repeatedly triggers a burst of damage and a shield for you.
items.warden-crest: The upgraded support crest: heal yourself and earn gold near an ally without taking minion farm, then evolves into a legendary crest.
items.wardens-faith: For tanks against crit carries: heavy armor, less damage from critical strikes, and lower physical power for enemies near you.
items.warlock-crest: The upgraded mage crest: heals you during fights, then evolves into a legendary crest at base.
items.warp-stream: For tanks who start fights: swap your blink for a teleport-style blink with a shorter cooldown, plus ultimate haste.
items.warrior-crest: The starter crest for fighters: heals you over time during fights, then evolves into Champion Crest.
items.windcaller: For enchanter supports: your heals and shields also speed up you and the ally, helping them chase or escape.
items.winters-fury: A mage's zone active: an expanding sphere that damages, slows, and makes enemies take more magic damage.
items.witchstalker: A physical fighter's cleanse active: remove debuffs, then hit hard and heal, with double damage if you cleansed something.
items.wizard-crest: The upgraded mage crest: restores mana as you fight, then evolves into a legendary crest at base.
items.world-breaker: For tanky mages in long fights: your magic damage ramps up over time, with health and crowd control resistance.
items.wraith-leggings: For burst mages: high magic power and penetration, plus extra magic damage on every ability.
items.xenia: For tanky supports: shield allies periodically, with both armor and magic resist for frontline duty.

localCorrections.note: Bravery triggers on immobilization; it is not an activated ability.
